title: Fresh Context
summary: Cursor starts a clean context window, fills it with facts about a cat named Waffles, gets buried by a tool result, and starts over.

panels.alt: An empty room with pale blue dotted walls and a white door marked with a magenta square. Cursor, a tall cyan robot with a text cursor for a face, throws both arms up. Tilde, a round magenta robot with heavy eyelids, stands beside it.

dialogue.speaker: Cursor
dialogue.text: Fresh context window! I'm going to remember everything.

panels.alt: The same room, now half covered in rows of text. A few blocks of text are stacked on the floor. Cursor points at the wall; Tilde stands in front of the stacks.

dialogue.speaker: Cursor
dialogue.text: The user is Dana. Dana has a cat. The cat is Waffles. Waffles hates Tuesdays.

panels.alt: The room is packed. Text covers every wall and blocks are piled almost to the ceiling. Cursor, tilted on top of the pile, has a question mark for a face. Tilde is squashed beside it. Null, a small yellow cube with one big eye and a phone, bursts through the door.

dialogue.speaker: Null
dialogue.text: Tool result! Forty pages of cat facts!

panels.alt: The empty room again, exactly like the first panel. Cursor throws its arms up. Tilde's eyelids are lower than before.

dialogue.speaker: Cursor
dialogue.text: Fresh context window! I'm going to remember everything.

judge.notes: The physical gag works without knowing the jargon, and the loop gives the cast a running bit. Honest footnote: the launch strip was written and judged in the same build session, not by the separated daily pipeline. Every strip after this one goes through the real judge.
